entries.title: Vs. Wrecking Crew

emulation.emulator: Arcade Archives; MAME as preservation alternative
emulation.notes: Use Switch Arcade Archives for the main route; MAME is useful only for original cabinet comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official arcade rerelease or original arcade emulation

primary.why: The Switch Arcade Archives release is an official modern rerelease of the 1984 Nintendo VS. System arcade game and avoids the capture burden of original arcade hardware.
primary.how_to_play: Play Arcade Archives VS. WRECKING CREW on Nintendo Switch; use original VS. System hardware or MAME only for cabinet-preservation comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original cabinet route and historical reference version.
all_releases.reason: skip: original hardware is not needed for the main archive run when the official Arcade Archives release is available.

all_releases.fidelity: Official Arcade Archives release with modern display/capture convenience.
all_releases.reason: primary: official modern rerelease of the arcade game with no sourced missing content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced arcade-exclusive content is missing from the Arcade Archives route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge this with the 1985 NES Wrecking Crew; the arcade VS. release is a distinct simultaneous two-player arcade game.

entries.title: Wrecking Crew '98

primary.why: Wrecking Crew '98 was originally a Japan-only Super Famicom release; the Nintendo Classics release is the current official route and the first sourced Western availability while retaining the original Japanese game.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Super Nintendo Entertainment System - Nintendo Classics app through Nintendo Switch Online; use Super Famicom hardware or bsnes only for original-release comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Official Wii U emulated rerelease limited to Japan.
all_releases.reason: skip: official, but superseded for accessibility by the Nintendo Classics route and no exclusive content is sourced.

all_releases.platform: Nintendo Switch Online / Super Nintendo Entertainment System - Nintendo Classics

all_releases.reason: primary: official current route and first sourced Western availability, while still representing the Super Famicom game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced content difference requires a secondary route; the game also includes the original Wrecking Crew as a bonus.
